children: CEO Michael Novogratz is the latest billionaire investor to weigh in on the AI trade, saying it is in the "biggest bubble of our lifetime" and traders should ride the wave.
"Bubbles don't end like we are today," Novogratz said during a panel discussion at the Greenwich Economic Forum, as reported by
. "I know how bubbles end, and they end spectacularly, and this isn't spectacular enough."

He also noted that AI-related stocks still look cheap on a price-to-earnings basis. "If you were not invested in AI, you might as well just go home and put your head in a bucket of ice," said Novogratz, who was also an early investor of bitcoin
